description: One-to-one provider-component binding and fail-closed handoff from a prospective BLS roster window into the shadow-campaign schedule contract.

binding_rules.coverage: Every logical component registered for the selected roster window must bind exactly once.
binding_rules.identity: Provider event IDs must be non-empty and unique inside one release bundle.
binding_rules.schedule: Every provider component must have the exact registered release timestamp.
binding_rules.capture: The binding must name the immutable pre-release capture receipt from which provider IDs were resolved.
binding_rules.eligibility: Only a licensed vendor snapshot with every required right may produce an executable handoff; synthetic fixtures remain structural previews.

handoff_rules.activation: The Phase 6 activation packet must be READY_FOR_ACTIVATION before an executable schedule or permit can be emitted.
handoff_rules.freshness: The binding capture must fall inside the registered schedule-refresh window and must not be in the future at evaluation.
handoff_rules.immutability: Seal roster, binding, schedule and activation-packet hashes into the handoff.
handoff_rules.expiry: An executable handoff expires at the release time and cannot authorize historical reconstruction.
handoff_rules.scope: The handoff authorizes capture operations only; it never authorizes a price join, model or order.
